formats.national: AA XXXX XXXX (2-digit area code) / AAA XXX XXXX (3-digit area code)

examples.note: Mobile — since the 2019 reform mobiles share geographic area codes and are indistinguishable by format

notes: Mexico reformed its plan on 2019-08-03: all calls now use a uniform 10-digit number and the old prefixes 01 (long distance), 044 and 045 (mobile) were abolished.
Since the reform, mobile and fixed numbers are drawn from the same area codes and cannot be told apart by format alone — the +521 mobile prefix once required from abroad is also obsolete.
The first digit of the area code indicates a broad region: 2 East, 3 West, 4 North, 5 Centre, 6 Northwest, 7 South, 8 Northeast, 9 Southeast.
sources: IFT — Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones: https://www.ift.org.mx/
